DROP PROCEDURE [OM].[SP_LOG_TASK_ERROR_DTL]
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE PROC [OM].[SP_LOG_TASK_ERROR_DTL] @pipeline_runid [VARCHAR](50),@task_name [varchar](100),@data_layer [nvarchar](150),@process_date [datetime],@error_desc [varchar](2000) AS

BEGIN

			INSERT INTO 
			[OM].[OM_TASK_ERROR_DTL] 
			(
				 [PIPELINE_RUNID]
				,[TASK_NAME]
				,[DATA_LAYER]
				,[PROCESS_DATE]
				,[ERROR_DESC]
				,[CREATE_DATETIME]

			)
			SELECT  
				 @pipeline_runid
				,UPPER(@task_name)
				,UPPER(@data_layer)
				,@process_date
				,@error_desc
				,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime)	

			UPDATE [OM].[OM_TASK_RUN] 
				SET [STATUS_ID]=(SELECT STATUS_ID FROM OM.OM_STATUS WHERE STATUS='FAILED'),
				[END_DATETIME]=CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime)
			WHERE 
				UPPER(TASK_NAME)=UPPER(@task_name) 
				AND [PROCESS_DATE]=@process_date
				AND CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) BETWEEN [START_DATETIME] AND COALESCE([END_DATETIME],CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime))
	
END

--GO
GO
